nodes.name: Sklearn GraphicalLassoCV Path Postprocessing Helpers
nodes.description: Deterministic GraphicalLassoCV fit-shell helpers for sorting merged path records, unpacking alpha and score arrays, appending the empirical covariance baseline, and selecting the final alpha before the deferred sparse precision refit.
